ideas.pitch: An automated strategy execution engine that analyzes crowd forecasting data from Glimpse and compares it against live funding rates and perpetual futures pricing to execute delta-neutral arbitrage.
ideas.title: GlimpseCrowdArbitrage
ideas.why_it_could_win: It leverages the exact unique dataset provided by Glimpse—what thousands of people believe will happen next—and turns it into a financial tool, directly aligning with the core mission of the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that takes a user's initial 5,000 sats provided by Glimpse and autonomously places forecasts on Bitcoin and Solana price targets based on real-time sentiment analysis and technical indicators.
ideas.title: SatsAgentForecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges looking for products built at the intersection of AI agents, Bitcoin, and forecasting markets will immediately see the utility of an automated forecasting portfolio manager.

ideas.pitch: A social copy-forecasting platform that lets users track the top-performing forecasters on Glimpse using their satoshi balances, allowing smaller participants to mirror the predictions of historical winners automatically.
ideas.title: GlimpseCopyTrader
ideas.why_it_could_win: It solves the onboarding friction for new forecasters by letting them immediately leverage the top alpha on the platform, presenting a polished product ready for the Glimpse portfolio.

ideas.pitch: A self-custodial smart contract vault that automatically locks USDC or Bitcoin collateral and uses Glimpse forecast outcomes as an oracle trigger to hedge user spot portfolios against major market drops.
ideas.title: PredictionHedgeVault
ideas.why_it_could_win: It expands Glimpse data beyond a simple game into a functional hedging primitive, proving that crowdsourced forecasts can secure actual financial risk management tools.

ideas.pitch: A real-time analytics dashboard aggregating prediction shifts on Glimpse for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Gold to generate quantified market sentiment indices and volatility alerts for traders.
ideas.title: SentimentAlphaDashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Glimpse specifically highlights the unique dataset of what thousands of people believe will happen next; this project directly exposes that dataset as a valuable institutional-grade tool.
